PRIMO Actor takes notes:
- quoteNumber: 8920121

PRIMO Actor takes notes:
- selectedCarrier: 1525
Then the response status should be 200
PRIMO Actor ensures that the status of the last response does equal 200
And the response contains a valid quote number
PRIMO Actor ensures that quote number does have value greater than 0
When the actor books the Portal shipment
PRIMO Actor books the LTL shipment
PRIMO Actor records the book request payload
